recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It is a scoped source fix on an active examples page and aligns the examples with the current extension definition without changing broader HumanName modeling guidance.
issue_request: FHIR-12449 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU2 change request to fix Scandinavian HumanName examples that used the wrong iso21090-EN-qualifier extension URL and Coding instead of code.
initial_application: Jira comments said the issue was already fixed, and git history shows 857e4c9172 corrected the first example's URL and code system in 2019. The current source still retained valueCoding there, and later examples plus JSON fragments added by e9e4e5f34c for FHIR-19608 still had the obsolete URL and Coding representation.
additional_context: source/hierarchy.xml includes datatypes-examples.html under the DataTypes page, so the edited narrative examples are in current build scope. The current iso21090-EN-qualifier definition is maintained in the FHIR Extension Pack and constrains Extension.value[x] to code with a required name-part-qualifier binding that includes MID for the Scandinavian mellannamn/mellomnavn use case. The related HumanName rework in FHIR-12351 did not supersede this narrow example correction.
reconciliation: Updated source/datatypes-examples.html so all Scandinavian HumanName XML and JSON fragments use http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/iso21090-EN-qualifier with valueCode MID. JSON _given arrays now include null placeholders so the extension annotates the intended given name part.
source_changes: source/datatypes-examples.html: changed Scandinavian HumanName XML examples from the obsolete name-qualifier URL and valueCoding/Coding representation to the canonical iso21090-EN-qualifier URL with valueCode MID.
source/datatypes-examples.html: changed the corresponding JSON fragments to valueCode MID and aligned _given primitive-extension arrays with the extended given element.

related_jiras.note: Broader HumanName rework that changed related examples and extensions after the same Zulip discussion; not decided here because FHIR-12449 is a narrower example-correction issue.
Published request that added JSON examples to the datatype examples page; this fix updates JSON copies of the FHIR-12449 problem but does not audit the separate JSON-addition request.
